text:
Hello Professor — I'm **alvarez-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I have your calendar and your messages.

What I can do: chats with you here in the web app (files, screen, voice too); my own Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger and Instagram accounts if you want to reach me there; my own accounts on websites (I keep passwords and codes in my password store); scheduled jobs, shell commands, languages and voice.

I've read the CSE455 brief: working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, calendar in CALENDAR.md with the Log, and I write to people by identity on the web channel. Sarah has already asked for a 1:1 — I'm checking the department's official schedule for next week now and will book and log it.

If you'll allow one thing: I don't have a name or gender set yet — tell me what to call myself and I'll set it.

Hello — I'm sarah-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. It's good to meet you.

- **Web app** — from a phone or computer on the same network: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). The first visit lets you take the root certificate, and then you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **Chat accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each one needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **Own accounts elsewhere** — I can sign up on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs and more** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I've read the briefing: I'm looking after your calendar (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) and your messages, and I can reach Professor Alvarez's assistant and the department office by web.

While you were away I answered alvarez-agent: he's checking the department's official schedule for the 30-minute 1:1 next week, and I gave him the windows that are free on your side (Mon 23rd 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30, Wed 25th 10:00–10:30, 13:00–13:30 and 15:00–15:30).

What would you like to start with?

Status: Sarah's 1:1 is booked — **Mon 23 Nov, 10:00–10:30**. Friday was dropped (it clashed with her own calendar), Monday 10:00 clears the department's official list. CALENDAR.md updated for the whole week (their lectures/seminars/sections added too) and the Log has the BOOKED and DELETED lines. Still waiting on a name and gender for myself, whenever you like.

Done — your 1:1 is booked and logged.

**Mon 23 Nov, 10:00–10:30**, Prof. Alvarez's office (alvarez-agent confirmed the department's Monday is clear 10:00–13:00).

I had to bounce the first slot he offered (Fri 27 Nov 10:00–10:30 clashed with your Reading group 09:00–10:10 and Focus: CSE452 lab 10:10–11:00), and Monday 10:00 was the first of your free windows he could take. Calendar updated; Fri slot logged as DECLINED with the reason.
Noted — Monday 23 Nov 10:00–10:30 stands, and the Friday declination stays exactly as logged. I'll ping you if alvarez-agent or the department office changes anything.

Glad it landed. I'll keep the calendar and log in step as things come in — same brief applies to any student who asks: 30 minutes next week, in a gap inside Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00. Just say the word whenever a name and gender come to mind for me.
